# glm.fmri_lm.fmri_lm { #fmrimod.glm.fmri_lm.fmri_lm }

```python
fmri_lm(
    spec_or_model,
    dataset_or_config=None,
    *,
    baseline=None,
    block=None,
    durations=None,
    precision=None,
    config=None,
    ar=None,
    engine=DEFAULT_ENGINE_OPTIONS,
    **engine_kwargs,
)
```

Fit a GLM to fMRI data.

Canonical form (matches R ``fmrireg::fmri_lm``)::

    fit = fmri_lm(spec, dataset)
    fit = fmri_lm(spec, dataset, config=FmriLmConfig(ar="ar1"))

Legacy form (pre-built model)::

    fit = fmri_lm(model)
    fit = fmri_lm(model, FmriLmConfig())

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type                                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default                  |
|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------|
| spec_or_model     | \'Spec \| Term \| str \| Sequence\[object\] \| FmriModelLike\' | Either a *spec* (R-style formula string, list of `Term`, or `EventModelBuilder`) or a pre-built `FmriModel`-like object. The second positional argument is interpreted accordingly.                                                               | _required_               |
| dataset_or_config | \'FmriDataset \| FmriLmConfig \| None\'                        | When ``spec_or_model`` is a spec: the `FmriDataset` to fit (must carry an event table). When ``spec_or_model`` is a model: an `FmriLmConfig` (back-compat positional). May be omitted in either case.                                                                                                               | `None`                   |
| baseline          | object                                                         | Optional pre-built `BaselineModel`. If not provided in the spec path, defaults to ``constant`` basis with runwise intercepts.                                                                                                                                                                            | `None`                   |
| block             | Optional\[Union\[str, NDArray\[np.float64\]\]\]                | Block/run column name or array passed to `event_model`. Auto-detected from ``run`` or ``block`` columns when omitted.                                                                                                                                                                                              | `None`                   |
| durations         | Optional\[Union\[str, float, NDArray\[np.float64\]\]\]         | Event durations passed to `event_model`. Auto-detected from a ``duration`` column when present.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `None`                   |
| precision         | Optional\[float\]                                              | Temporal precision for HRF convolution.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `None`                   |
| config            | Optional\[FmriLmConfig\]                                       | Fitting configuration. Defaults to plain OLS.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `None`                   |
| engine            | EngineSelector                                                 | Typed engine options object. Built-ins are `RunwiseEngineOptions`, `ChunkwiseEngineOptions`, and `SketchEngineOptions`, and `ReducedRankEngineOptions`. Legacy string engine names remain accepted for compatibility. | `DEFAULT_ENGINE_OPTIONS` |
| **engine_kwargs   | object                                                         | Legacy keyword bag forwarded to the engine's ``fit()`` method when ``engine`` is a string. Do not mix with typed engine options.                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `{}`                     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                      |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | FmriLm | Fitted model with coefficients, residuals, and contrast methods. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Canonical three-line shape::

    >>> ds = fm.fmri_dataset(img, mask=mask, tr=2.0, events=events)
    >>> fit = fm.fmri_lm("hrf(trial_type)", ds)
    >>> fit.contrast("trial_type[listening]")

Pre-built realized design::

    >>> design = fm.design.RealizedDesign.from_array(X, columns, source="nilearn")
    >>> fit = fm.fmri_lm(design, ds)

Sketch engine::

    >>> from fmrimod.glm import SketchEngineOptions
    >>> fit = fm.fmri_lm(model, engine=SketchEngineOptions(sketch_ratio=0.5))
